meaning_en: Family — in the extended sense, including all descendants and connected lines, not just the household.
meaning_sm: O le aiga atoa, e aofia ai uso, tuagane, ma le gafa atoa, ae le na o le aiga vavalalata.

meaning_en: The whole extended family gathered — the decision-making body of the aiga.
meaning_sm: O le aiga atoa ua potopoto — o le aoao e faia faʻaiʻuga mo le aiga.

meaning_en: A chief — one of the two main classes of matai. Ali'i represent the dignity and lineage of the title.
meaning_sm: Aliʻi — o se tasi o vasega muamua e lua o matai. E faʻaali e aliʻi le mamalu ma le gafa o le suafa.

meaning_en: Kava — the ceremonial drink prepared from the root of Piper methysticum. The 'ava ceremony opens formal matai gatherings.
meaning_sm: ʻAva — o le mea inu paia ua palu mai i le aʻa o le ʻava. E tatala ai aofia o matai.

meaning_en: A major family obligation — most often a funeral, wedding, saofa'i, or other family event requiring contribution. Both the event and the contribution are called fa'alavelave.
meaning_sm: O se faʻalavelave i le aiga — e masani ai i maliu, faʻaipoipoga, saofaʻi, ma isi mea e manaʻomia ai se fesoasoani. E taʻua le sauniga ma le fesoasoani o le faʻalavelave.

meaning_en: The chiefly system — the social and political structure of Samoa, organising aiga and nu'u under matai.
meaning_sm: O le faʻamatai — o le faiga ma le faasoasoa o aiga ma nuʻu i Sāmoa, e taʻitaʻi e matai.

meaning_en: Wedding ceremony.
meaning_sm: O le sauniga o le faʻaipoipoga.

meaning_en: Minister of the church. Holds significant authority alongside the matai in village life.
meaning_sm: O le taʻitaʻi o le ekalesia. E tāua lona pule faʻatasi ma matai i le ola o le nuʻu.

meaning_en: A village representative — historically, a matai who held a political/legislative role.
meaning_sm: O se sui o le nuʻu — o se matai sa umia se tofi faʻapolokiki.

meaning_en: A formal meeting — of the village (fono a le nu'u), of the aiga, or of the country.
meaning_sm: O se fonotaga aloaʻia — o le nuʻu, o le aiga, po o le atunuʻu.

meaning_en: A ceremonial act of contrition in which the offending aiga sits under fine mats at the home of the offended aiga, awaiting acceptance and forgiveness.
meaning_sm: O le sauniga o le faʻaleleiga, e nonofo ai le aiga ua sese i lalo o ʻie tōga i le aiga ua sese i ai, e faʻatali seʻi talia.

meaning_en: Fine mats — the highest cultural currency in Samoa, woven from pandanus, presented at every major fa'alavelave.
meaning_sm: O ʻie tōga — o le mea sili ona tāua i le aganuʻu Sāmoa, e lalaga i le lau o le paogo, e tuʻuina atu i faʻalavelave.

meaning_en: A formal Samoan oratorical speech — opens and closes every formal gathering. Follows a strict order: God, the place, the matai, the family, the matter at hand.
meaning_sm: O le lauga aloaʻia — e tatala ma faʻaiʻu ai soʻo se aofia aloaʻia. E mulimuli i le faʻasologa: le Atua, le nofoaga, matai, le aiga, ma le mataupu.

meaning_en: The ceremonial son of a chief — counterpart to the taupou. Holds an honoured place in the procession.
meaning_sm: O le atalii faʻaaloalogia o se matai — e tutusa ma le taupou. E iai lona nofoaga faʻaaloalogia.

meaning_en: A holder of a Samoan chiefly title. Matai are responsible to their aiga and to their village.
meaning_sm: O lē e umia se suafa Sāmoa. E i ai le tiute o matai i lo latou aiga ma le nuʻu.

meaning_en: Village. The fundamental unit of Samoan social structure.
meaning_sm: O le nuʻu — o le iunite muamua o le faasoasoa o le aganuʻu Sāmoa.

meaning_en: The ceremony of bestowing a matai title.
meaning_sm: O le sauniga o le tuʻuina atu o se suafa matai.

meaning_en: The head matai of an aiga — holds the senior title and authority.
meaning_sm: O le matai sili o se aiga — e umia le suafa maualuga ma le pule.

meaning_en: Carved wooden bowl in which the 'ava is prepared.
meaning_sm: O le ipu laʻau tofitofi e palu ai le ʻava.

meaning_en: The person who mixes the 'ava — often the taupou.
meaning_sm: O le tagata e palu le ʻava — e masani lava ona avea ma taupou.

meaning_en: The ceremonial daughter of a chief — traditional preparer of the 'ava and ceremonial representative.
meaning_sm: O le afafine faʻaaloalogia o se matai — e masani ona palu le ʻava ma fai ma sui aloaʻia.

meaning_en: The Sunday lunch — the weekly family meal after church.
meaning_sm: O le taumafataga o le Aso Sa ina ua maeʻa le lotu.

meaning_en: Talking chief / orator. Tulafale carry the speech rights and ceremonial knowledge of the aiga.
meaning_sm: Tulafale — o le matai e fofogaina lauga ma faʻaali le poto o le aganuʻu o le aiga.

meaning_en: The traditional above-ground earth oven of hot stones — the Samoan way of cooking the Sunday meal.
meaning_sm: O le umu — o le faʻasaga masani Sāmoa e faʻaogāina maʻa vevela e vela ai le taumafataga o le Aso Sa.

meaning_en: Service. The cultural value of serving one's aiga and village — the path to leadership runs through tautua.
meaning_sm: O le tautua — o le faʻaaogāina o le tagata mo le aiga ma le nuʻu. O le ala i le pule, o le tautua.
